topic: Analytics access and contact setup issues
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on difficulties accessing client data in analytics. Initially, the user requested checks to ensure default installation settings were consistent with Joe&TheJuice (JCD) standards and that associated contacts were properly configured for specific accounts.

Later, [me] updated two clients under JCD HQ. However, both [me] and the other participant noted that contact details were still not visible under these entries. The user requested to provide emails so that the missing contacts could be manually entered.
decisions: Client data setup was addressed by entering accounts under JCD HQ.
action_items: The user needs to provide email addresses for [me] to input missing contact information.
